profile.headline: Software Developer | .NET | C#
profile.summary: I have completed the .NET boot camp at Tech Elevator Cincinnati.  As a Tech Elevator student, I built a Vending Machine Application in C#, a money transfer API service using the .NET framework, and a full service parking valet web application using the Vue.js framework.  These were group projects where we practiced the Agile methodology as we built the components.  I have a doctorate in education and have spent much of my career as an educator and administrator in higher education.  I always enjoyed working with software and building applications and web pages.  I would frequently code applications and databases using Visual Basic and SQL.  After learning JavaScript and Python through FreeCodeCamp, I decided to make a career shift to software development and enrolled in Tech Elevator to upgrade my coding skills.  As a lifelong learner, I know I’ve only touched the tip of the iceberg when it comes to coding. I look forward to gaining more experience and knowledge in future roles as a junior/full stack developer or similar role.

positions.title: Director, Academic Success Center
positions.description:
•	Administered all operations including interdepartmental and faculty collaboration and strategic planning
•	Managed three full time staff members and over a dozen part-time staff and student workers
•	Supervised data and communication operations for center.

positions.title: Director Of Student Services
positions.description:
•	Managed tutoring services, career services, and accessibility office, early alert notification system for struggling students, Form and style review for dissertations, emergency funds grant for students, and online student orientation
•	Supervised Academic Probation and Academic Recovery program for students on probation
•	Supervised pilot for first year, first time students—implemented Winter 1819 Acad Year

positions.title: Writing Center Coordinator
positions.description:
•	Managed on-line writing center tutoring services and math tutoring services for undergraduate and graduate programs
•	Monitored tutoring costs and assisted with budget.
•	Worked with IT department to create on-line forms for students and staff
•	Created and managed database and notification system for entire tutoring operation including appointments, usage, and communication for students, faculty, and advisors.

positions.title: Writing, Tutoring, and Educational Consultant
positions.description:
•	Specialize in tutoring reading and writing and editing writing projects
•	Work with Learners and Clients to provide adequate support for them to accomplish objectives
•	Coordinated Extended Learning Program at Hays Porter Elementary in Cincinnati, OH from January 2011 to May 2011.  
•	Work with Pre-cohort PhD students at Union Institute & University per institutions request essentially coaching the students through the revision of their dissertation.
